items.title: Study Examines 19 AI Video API Models; BytePlus Was the Only Provider Whose Contract Tier Could Be Verified by Signature
items.summary: A study of 605 videos from 19 commercial video-generation API models found that source-attribution accuracy based on file characteristics varied with testing conditions. Under the researchers' trust policy, BytePlus's Seedance family was the only one whose signed tier names could be matched to the ordered tiers.

items.title: AI Automatically Improves RISC-V CPU Circuits, Delivering 2.34x Performance in Research Evaluation by Jointly Optimizing IPC and Clock Speed
items.summary: A research team at UC Berkeley used AI to improve BOOM, a RISC-V CPU, producing a design called BLOOM. On SPEC CPU2017, its estimated execution performance combining IPC with a synthesized frequency for a 130nm process reached 2.34x the baseline, improving instruction efficiency and circuit delay together.
